description: This file defines the VacancyService class within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It contains a private property for VacancyDao, a getter method that initializes and returns this DAO object, and a namespace declaration. It serves as a service layer component for managing vacancy-related operations.

classes.name: VacancyService
classes.description: Service class to manage vacancy data access objects, providing lazy loading for the VacancyDao.

methods.name: getVacancyDao
methods.description: Returns the VacancyDao instance, creating it if it doesn't already exist.
